creator: Alexander Terp
description:
MIP-3, Consequences. After the cut, users' old herdr daemons keep running until their panes end. `muster daemons` prints a herdr stop command today (`crates/muster-cli/src/render.rs:883`) and the records under `~/.muster/state/daemons/` have no field naming the backend; `./dev --doctor` finds daemons by the `herdr` process name and the `terminal session control` argv.

For the first release with `muster-daemon`, both commands should list new daemons with what they hold, and old herdr daemons as herdr daemons with how to stop them. A later release can drop the herdr half.
title: muster daemons and ./dev --doctor recognize both daemons for the transition release
